**(c) LL weights released jointly with the deformation** (comment 024 §8).
The pilot froze the LL0–LL1 weights at (½, ½, 0). The static optimum was
found with those weights and a k-independent envelope; with a k-dependent
envelope the best weights may move, and LL2 admixture may become useful.
Vary `a_n` (including a small LL2 component) together with the
first-star deformation, and check whether the static LL optimum is still
optimal once the envelope can depend on k.
